title: Casa
summary: After Arthur's doctor reports that chemotherapy is responding well, Adrian develops Project Casa Arthur as a conditional housing plan tied to safe travel and independent medical approval.
keyEvents: Dr. Richard Collins first appears as Arthur Fletcher's doctor and medical information provider.
Owen feels guilty about being far from Arthur.
Project Casa Arthur is planned within the Kairos campus property with one bedroom, a living room, kitchen, garden, full accessibility, and proximity to medical resources.
The plan is conditional on safe travel and independent medical approval.
No construction, relocation, acceptance, or medical approval occurs.
The episode occurs some days after the first internal Counter-Strike scrim.
consequences: The plan remains conditional and Arthur continues living in Mackenzie.
The concept is intended to help Owen balance career and family.
canonIntroduced: Project Casa Arthur is a planned conditional facility, not a completed residence.
